checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas computed before memory allocation?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Call ModExp with large lengths and minimal gas. 2. Monitor memory allocation during the call. 3. Verify NO memory is allocated before gas check fails. 4. Review code order: parse lengths -> compute gas -> check gas -> allocate. 5. Test with lengths designed to trigger OOM if allocation came first.

checklist_item.title: Do specific EIP-7883 test vectors produce expected gas costs?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Test vector 1: base=1, mod=1, exp=1, exp_val=2 -> gas=500. 2. Test vector 2: base=64, mod=64, exp=64, bit_length=256 -> gas=98176. 3. Execute on all clients and compare. 4. Document exact gas consumed for each. 5. Alert on any deviation from expected values.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B12-48, Trust Boundaries: tb-007, tb-008.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7825 gas cap activated only at Fusaka fork block?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit gasLimit > 16777216 transaction at fork block - 1. 2. Verify it is accepted (pre-fork behavior). 3. Submit same transaction at fork block. 4. Verify it is rejected (post-fork behavior). 5. Compare fork activation across all clients.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W3B12-49, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-003.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7883 ModExp formula activated only at Fusaka fork block?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Execute ModExp at fork block - 1 and record gas (EIP-2565 formula). 2. Execute identical ModExp at fork block and record gas (EIP-7883 formula). 3. Verify gas difference matches formula change (removal of /3, minimum 500). 4. Compare across all clients. 5. Alert on any activation timing mismatch.
